messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed ~15% unit-cost bump for /chat-stream yesterday around 18:30 UTC. Token cost report shows higher per-token latency slice for tail tokens.
sasha: ugh. any obvious kernel changes or rollout that timeframe?
alex: I checked kernel rollout logs — no explicit model swap, but kernel-selector reported a sudden increase in fallback-to-generic (nv_generic_v2) for sequences > 1024. Profiling snippet attached below.
mina: can you paste the query you used to see that? i want to reproduce.
alex: query I ran in observability:
```
select kernel, count(*) as c, avg(token_latency_ms) as lat
from runtime_traces
where route = '/chat-stream' and ts > '2026-03-16T18:00:00Z'
group by kernel
order by lat desc
```
alex: result: nv_generic_v2 had 2.1x avg token latency vs preferred kernel (nv_opt_attn). Also KV-miss rate rose from 3% -> 9% at the same time.
chris: that KV spike smells like cache key encoding mismatch from recent KVS change. any errors in kv proxy logs?
mina: i checked kv-proxy — there was a rolling restart of the worker pool at 18:20, cause: OOM on a single node; restarts were throttled. Could explain temporary misses.
sasha: so two hypotheses: 1) kernel-selector falls back when sequence length distribution shifts (batches crossing threshold) or 2) KV miss spike forces cold KVs -> longer token latency -> kernel selector observes latency and picks safe kernel.
jamie: for the instrumentation side we should add kernel_choice and kv_hit boolean to the per-token trace and to the token-econ events. Right now token-econ events only have route/model/latency/token_count.
telemetry-bot: reminder: adding fields to token-econ events requires schema bump + downstream ETL mapping update. See docs: https://internal.redwood/telemetry/schema
mina: agreed. quick plan: (a) add kernel_choice (string) and kv_miss (bool) to span-level tags, (b) emit summarized token-econ line with kernel_choice and kv_miss_count per request, (c) update grafana dashboard to show per-route kernel split and token-cost delta per kernel.
alex: also suggest sampling per-route traces more during peak windows — we have 1% sampling now; bump to 5% for /chat-stream for next 6 hours to capture more examples.
sasha: does kernel-selector already export decision metrics? iirc it emits a histogram for seq_len but not the final kernel label.
nina: (typo: mina) kernel-selector currently exposes chosen_kernel as debug only. We'll flip to prod metric with cardinality-limited labels.
chris: caution: chosen_kernel can be high-cardinality if we include quant+arch variants. limit to a short set: nv_opt_attn, nv_generic_v2, fallback_cpu.
mina: will implement limit and add kv_hit as boolean. I'll also add a small perf test to reproduce: run 500 concurrent requests with seeds that create long prefixes > 1100 tokens and toggled KV warm/cold.
alex: can we add a dashboard panel showing cost-per-token by kernel and by kv_hit? something like stacked bars: kernel on x, average token latency and cost on y, and separate series for kv_hit/kv_miss.
jamie: yes — i'll prototype a panel and attach the JSON config. we should also compute a corrective billing-adjustment view: reconcile token-econ totals with billing export (we've seen ~0.6% mismatch historically). the new kernel+kv labels should help isolate the delta.
telemetry-bot: action created: TELEM-5423 "Add kernel_choice + kv_miss to token-econ events" assigned to mina, due 2026-03-18T23:59:00Z
sasha: quick checklist for Mina: a) schema bump PR, b) runtime span/tagging change, c) event emission change, d) ETL mapping + unit tests, e) dashboard PR.
mina: copying here the minimal change patch I'll push:
```
- emit_token_econ(route, model, tokens, lat_ms)
+ emit_token_econ(route, model, tokens, lat_ms, kernel_choice=kernel, kv_miss_count=kv_miss ? 1 : 0)
```
mina: i'll start the PR and link TELEM-5423. rolling deploy to prod with 10% traffic first.
alex: once data flows in, let's run a 24h compare: cost-per-token before vs after label, and run a join with billing_export to see if mismatch reduces.
chris: if we still see kernel fallbacks correlated with kv misses, we should change kernel-selector to consult kv_miss_predictor (simple last-seen hit rate) and prefer low-latency kernels when KV warm.
jamie: putting the dashboard prototype in a PR by EOD. tagging @sasha for review on the panel visualizations.
sasha: thanks. one more ask: add an alert if nv_generic_v2 share > 10% for any critical route for > 5 minutes.
mina: got it. i'll add the alert rule once metrics are emitted.
alex: nice sync. thanks team — schedule a 20m follow-up if we see regressions after the PR deploy.
sasha: :thumbsup:
telemetry-bot: TELEM-5423 updated: mina moved from "in progress" -> "in review" (link: https://git.internal/telem/5423)"
